bars.says: Colonists enter green canopy above low standing steam, with firm root routes through slow churnmud and foliage that obstructs pawn sight while close inspection still identifies the footing.

meant.intent: Ordinary land is a steaming, obstructed but readable place in which route choice matters.
meant.source: the_greentide.md sections 1, 4c, 8b; composition root; delegated from these pictures, subject to later Direct Sun and fixed-world rulings

accept: Low steam obscures ground detail while tree crowns and silhouettes remain readable; inspecting a cell identifies mud or root footing, and a colonist takes the root route around boggy undergrowth.
A shot or witnessed act is blocked by the mature sight-blocking understory; the player can still inspect the map and an open lane restores pawn sight.
reject: A green recolour of an open swamp, or a screen-wide grey fog that erases crowns and ground equally, leaves no distinct low-steam jungle.
Root texture is painted over mud but has the same footing, or a visible thicket allows pawn sight straight through it.
bars.lazy: none: Low steam versus readable crowns, real footing contrast and pawn sight obstruction all occur in the sentence; recoloured clear terrain or flat opaque fog cannot satisfy it.

range.varies: Full local maps 150x150, 250x250, 325x325; flat, large-hill and mountain relief; river, river edge and authored riverless-remnant contexts; leaf stages before/at/after sight threshold; approach bearings 0..359 degrees; camera normal/close; Roil, clearing and return; colony 1..40.
range.left_out: Planet generation and painting are excluded. A riverless remnant is not automatically a wet living-river example; no invented water or rosters. Artistic variants need the same legibility, not a fixed count.

bars.says: Colonists can bring useful alien food, timber and tameable grazing life out of a jungle whose falling trees, hunting predators and defending insects make the harvest dangerous, with readable signs and practical retreat.

meant.intent: The binding risk/reward exchange is present in ordinary life, not a zoo or a harmless larder.
meant.source: GREENTIDE_RISK_REWARD_EXCHANGE_1 owner ruling/card confirmation 2026-09-22; tree/understory rosters; kit silence card 2026-09-11; delegated practical harvest/retreat interpretation

figurative.stands_for: from dangerous living surroundings into useful colony stock and work, not compulsory departure from the biome
figurative.accept: A colony inside the jungle brings harvested fruit into its own kitchen and cooks it without leaving the biome.

accept: A forager finds edible fruit and roots, a fisher returns an exotic catch, a hunter brings meat and a herder keeps a grazer; fallen timber and resin are useful at home, while a cracking tree, concealed water hunt and disturbed gall each force a legible decision.

A gall found naturally beside its living host releases defending wasps when disturbed; retreat ends pursuit without erasing the insects, and a concealed hunt hushes biome ambience with a visible warning before the player can respond.
reject: Every pictured plant is decoration, useful catches require a debug spawn, or all danger exists in descriptions while harvesting is carefree.
Every route is permanently lethal even to a prepared party, warnings arrive only after unavoidable loss, or a threat vanishes silently when the party retreats.
A flying native walks throughout its ordinary travel, or the hum of machinery is muted instead of the biome hunt warning.
bars.lazy: none: Actual useful return, natural plant/predator/insect danger, readable signs and retreat are jointly required; a decorative zoo or debug-only harvest cannot satisfy those words.

range.varies: Natural mixed ecology across the map sizes and relief of B1, first day through day 60, colony 1/8/40; grazers wild/tamed/dead; flyers grounded/airborne; tree crack/gnaw/herd fall; gall intact/disturbed/spent; aquatic predator deep/shallow/land, hungry/fed, hunts started/ended/overlapping, native water and mud exposure; actual harvest, cooking, butchery, fishing and hauling with ordinary work priorities. Rare species need not occur in every map; their available behaviors are covered in generated situations.
range.left_out: No eviction, new cuisine crafting system, vurrak disguise, illisk armor, ant raid, extra plant attack or Greatbole harvest is needed. Gristle remains an ordinary predator and ookala an ordinary canopy-themed pawn until special travel is built later. Catch-only fish waiver is preserved.

bars.says: Repeated natural wet growth obstructs used unpaved routes between home, fields, harvest sites and river, allowing warned recovery before prolonged neglect leaves supplies beyond practical reach, while paving permanently protects the cells it covers from regrowth.

meant.intent: Defend productive access to an inhabited foothold on plant-eligible working ground; paving is an earned permanent answer to regrowth on covered cells, while neglect elsewhere causes recoverable loss before abandonment.
meant.source: ANSWERS_OWNER.md answers by card 2026-11-10: inhabited access and recovery-first neglect; the_greentide.md growth/door promise; delegated unpaved-working-ground interpretation constrained by later ExplosiveGrowth built-ground law and RM_ChurnmudSealed fertility exclusion

accept: After colonists repeatedly use an unpaved harvest or river approach, untreated vegetation returns and hauling slows or stops; visible encroachment alerts the player, who clears a usable rescue and retrieval path.
Paving the home entrance early permanently removes regrowth there even without blower suppression or grazing; workers still face returning vegetation on the unpaved routes they use outside it.

After prolonged neglect of used unpaved working ground, supplies can become impractical to reach while a maintained firm rescue route still reaches stranded people; ordinary clearing restores access without resetting the map.
reject: Plants mature faster in a specimen garden but used plant-eligible unpaved harvest and river routes never need maintenance, or only a forced growth explosion produces encroachment.
The jungle instantly bricks the only rescue route before a visible warning, or secretly spawns through paving, walls and enclosed rooms to fake pressure.
bars.lazy: none: Repeated natural obstruction is explicitly confined to used unpaved working routes, with warned recovery and permanent paved-cell exemption; neither fast specimen growth nor forced invasion of built ground qualifies.

range.varies: Light above/below shared growth threshold; wet-native immature/mature/wither/shared sprouting; plant-eligible unpaved route width 1..5 between inhabited home, field edges, harvest sites and river; cleared/neglected/recleared; paved entrances from first-day siting, later paving and constructed/sealed boundaries; day 1..60, colony 1/8/40, grazing present/lost, blower active/outage/repaired, clearing/return and mid-cycle save. Include early-paved-home policy with unpaved resource routes and a fully paved used-route negative control; record eligible cells, not merely unroofed cells.
range.left_out: Floors, walls and enclosed rooms remain exempt under the shared engine. No regrowth burden is required on wholly paved used ground, no compensating edge invasion, decay tax or escalation to defeat earned safety. Pressure applies where the colony continues to use plant-eligible ground; abandonment is possible after neglect, not mandatory for an engineered base. No new humidity or blackout-root law.

A named grazer suppresses cells without eating, an empty pen grants permanent immunity, or blower cooling heats an exhaust room.
Outage gives no readable sign until the entrance and all rescue paths have already failed.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires effective local prevention, actual eating, correct-side cooling and visible recoverable interruption, excluding checkbox/grid-only or global-immunity builds.

accept: A traveller crossing mud becomes visibly mired; a helper uses an in-place extraction followed by usable escape so both reach nearby firm footing; a prepared floor avoids the trap.

A loose stockpiled object sinks with a persistent cell marker; after reload, digging returns the same damaged, styled or perishable belonging, and blocked placement retains recoverable contents until room is made.
reject: The helper resets a health condition but both pawns immediately become trapped again, or natural colonist work selection never reaches the rescue job.
Digging creates a new pristine replacement, changes quality or biocode, duplicates a partially merged stack, or loses buried contents on reload.
Native wildlife is progressively mired at home, airborne animals sink while flying, or a corpse or carried object is silently swallowed as if it were loose cargo.
bars.lazy: none: Firm-ground extraction, prepared-footing contrast and the same recovered belongings exclude the known severity-reset and pristine-replacement shortcuts.

bars.says: Colonists see the floor as the Roil clears and shade-seeking natives head for roof shade more readily than under the steam, which returns when the clearing ends.

meant.intent: A readable variation of standing steam with the explicitly required natural animal response and return; shared heat-law compliance is R7 and regression evidence, not an additional player promise.
meant.source: greentide_kit_spec.md card 2026-09-11 requires seek-shade in first playable; delegated clearing/return reading. R7 separately follows the standing Direct Sun ruling and its tree-shade qualification.

accept: The low steam lifts, ground detail becomes visible and a grazer that stayed out under the Roil leaves exposed footing for a reachable roofed cell of its own accord. The low steam returns after the clearing.
reject: A clear-sky screenshot with weather locked permanently hides the return, or the grazer only seeks shade after a debug job is assigned.
The carrier heads for shelter just as often under the Roil as during a comparable clearing, so the clearing changes nothing it does.
bars.lazy: none: The visible floor, increased autonomous roof-seeking during clearing and natural return are explicit. A locked sky, forced job or unchanged sheltering cannot satisfy them.

range.left_out: Non-carrier animals and drafted human orders do not owe automatic seek-shade. The increased response is tested where Breaklight takes ordinary air through the carrier threshold and a roof is reachable. Below-threshold heat, continued sheltering when both arms are already hot and blocked-roof searches are boundary cases. Shared radiation and tree-shade readiness are tracked in C8/T38.

bars.says: Ambient Frenzy makes colonists work faster before a dangerous treatable collapse, while crafted stellock lace temporarily stops bleeding across wounds and stumps without replacing wound care.

meant.intent: Keep the disease-danger axis and unique medicine reward in ordinary life; deliberate infection, survivor progression and specimen discovery are deferred independent bargains.
meant.source: GREENTIDE_RISK_REWARD_EXCHANGE_1 binding disease/medicine axes; GREENTIDE_FRENZY_DISEASE_1 work/collapse/treatment contract and GREENTIDE_STELLOCK_LACE_BUILD_1 bleed-stop contract; delegated first-version subset. Dose, survivor and discovery rulings remain constraints on their deferred packages.

accept: An ordinary ambient illness produces visible faster work followed by collapse and real lost work; coma-stage care permits recovery while untreated collapse can kill, without deliberate dosing or an earned resistance reward.

After ordinary medicine research and crafting from resin and medical materials, a doctor or patient applies lace; bleeding stops across cuts and a stump while wounds remain untended, and can return on expiry unless ordinary care intervenes.
reject: A permanent work buff has a decorative fever name, collapse never costs real downtime, or untreated collapse is harmless.
Lace merely reduces bleeding from a cut while a stump still bleeds, or heals or tends the wounds instead of providing a temporary hold.
The medicine cannot be researched or crafted without enabling branch discovery, so the default colony never obtains the promised reward.
bars.lazy: none: Ambient faster work, consequential collapse and a treatment fork exclude a harmless buff; obtainable crafted lace must temporarily stop all wound and stump bleeding without tending or healing, excluding a cosmetic or inaccessible medicine.

range.varies: Ambient exposure, onset/escalation/collapse/recovery/death/early removal; 1/8/40 workers and available/tied-up/dead doctors; healthy and legacy-marked subjects with the deferred mark gate off; save at stage boundaries; ordinary MedicineProduction prerequisite, visible unfinished/finished lace research and real craft bills; lace self/administered, cuts/stumps/multiple wounds, tended/untended, expiry/reload. Existing flu/malaria replacements stand. Work multipliers, days of coma and lace duration are tuning/checks; actual lost work and treatment fork remain experience.

bars.says: A colony living through the complete Greentide cycle can earn and maintain a productive foothold, recover from neglect and continue after saving and returning, while the jungle remains threatening without overrunning the map, becoming barren, trapping routine work or filling the log with errors.

meant.intent: The first version running whole: abundance, pressure, defence, retrieval and recovery coexist rather than passing in isolated scenes.
meant.source: Owner cleanse brief whole-bar requirement 2026-11-16; owner inhabited-home/recovery/rescue answers 2026-11-10; binding danger/reward and flat-danger choice in GREENTIDE_RISK_REWARD_EXCHANGE_1

figurative.stands_for: a productive inhabited home with maintained working access, not a literal foot-sized hold
figurative.accept: An enclosed workshop and kitchen with maintained firm approaches is a productive home even though nobody stands on a special ledge.

accept: During ordinary work the colony gathers, cooks, fishes, builds, researches medicine, treats illness and maintains used unpaved working routes; a defence interruption there produces a visible problem, people and property are recovered, and upkeep restores productive work while living jungle persists outside.

After a mid-cycle reload the same threats, belongings, suppression expiry and work remain intelligible; doing harvest before upkeep or upkeep before harvest both permit a maintained foothold, and a clearing returns naturally to steam.

A colony paves its home entrances early and keeps them free of regrowth without suppression; returning plants still contest its used unpaved harvest and river routes, and care or further paving earns safe access without hidden escalation.
reject: A lush opening scene turns into unchecked vegetation or insect takeover, a stripped barren map, perpetual rescue/dig loops or repeated exceptions once growth, weather, predators and work run together.
The demonstration locks the sky clear, removes predators, forces every job or top event, leaves research locked, omits a mid-cycle reload, or depends on a deferred tool or landmark.
Everything resumes after load only because threats or buried belongings were reset, or the colony stays safe only while the script replenishes supplies.
bars.lazy: none: The complete cycle, maintained/recoverable home, continued save return and explicit flood/barren/stall/error exclusions rule out a staged safe afternoon or reload that erases the threats.

range.varies: Full maps 150/250/325 per side, each relief/water context from B1; a season of 15 game days per arm, extended beyond that until the required natural growth and Roil/clearing/return cycle has completed; an uneventful short run cannot be called a whole-cycle reading; small/new, working 8-colonist and 40-colonist colonies; maintained/outage/repaired/prolonged-neglect and early-paved-home-with-unpaved-working-ground policies; no repeated population/difficulty inflation. Save after day 7 during active suppression/burial/illness where feasible, reload and finish. Repeat from same baseline in the second action order. Rare conditional behavior gets B2/B6/B7 transition arms in addition to, never instead of, the default-season run. Main-action schedules preserve real prerequisites: stabilize/clear/pave then gather/process/research/care/retrieve versus gather/retrieve/care then stabilize/clear/pave/research/process; all main actions occur in both, without manufactured success or waived failures.
range.left_out: Worldgen, alternative worlds, deferred extras and absent-DLC configurations. Riverless remnants without enough water cannot stand in for an inhabited wet-river positive case. Engine tick acceleration is allowed; skipping growth, weather, hunger, job, illness, spawn or expiry ticks is not. No claim of enjoyment as a pass condition.

sees.instrument: Live full-season ordinary-play audit with timestamped state/work/economy/log trace and M2 calibrated whole-mod simulation. T34/T40 supply the replay and comparative orders. Compressed wall time must preserve game tick ordering and all named cycles.
sees.start: Fresh local map in the fixed-world context, or specified authored remnant negative arm; normal non-dev-supplied colony resources, enough preparatory unlocked technology to exercise the kept actions, loaded-content/settings fingerprints and initial ecosystem/property/work ledger; neither weather nor growth locked.
sees.on: All kept Greentide mechanics and their shared-engine gates at shipped defaults, all research/work prerequisites available, all DLC installed; next-version extras off. Natural weather clock unlocked. A paired mechanism-off control is supplemental, never the accepted run. Capture actual loaded content/settings fingerprints.
sees.control: Paired maintained/neglected zones and policy replays on the same saved local geometry isolate management from lucky terrain. Source-tagged births, damage, food and work account for outcomes; inspect all kept master gates and rates at start/mid/end so a disabled mechanism cannot explain apparent balance. Record interruptions rather than cleaning them away. Replay early entrance paving with the same starting construction resources and record material/work costs; count pressure on still-used eligible ground separately from permanent paved-cell exemption. Do not treat an earned safe doorway or a fully paved route as a missing mechanic.
sees.reset: Disposable baseline save plus settings/derived-def snapshot: reload baseline and restore prior values after each arm. Record loaded fingerprints and verify subjects, property, queues, weather and registrations match baseline. Never restore guessed defaults over prior user settings.
sees.live_only_why: Rendering/audio and the meaning of the running player scene cannot be inferred from defs or kernel outputs; model/state readings supply corroboration, not this judgment.

tests.reject: Required by Owner cleanse brief whole-bar requirement 2026-11-16; owner inhabited-home/recovery/rescue answers 2026-11-10; binding danger/reward and flat-danger choice in GREENTIDE_RISK_REWARD_EXCHANGE_1; a false outcome removes The first version running whole: abundance, pressure, defence, retrieval and recovery coexist rather than passing in isolated scenes.
tests.renormalize: No yield/stat/size/variant quota in the experience or pictures; retuning checks does not rewrite or re-pass this bar.
tests.first_version: Land, life, signature or explicit needed_by arguments in census.json; no deferred capability is assumed.

checks.what: Parse actual BiomeDef wildAnimals/wildPlants as element-name records, including available patch payloads; do not count li. Record current weights, density and forage values and a same-purpose vanilla swamp baseline as context, not bars.

Current literal baseline: plantDensity 0.99, movementDifficulty 4, animalDensity 3.2 in RM_Greentide_Biome.xml. movementDifficulty is world travel, not local footing. Sentinel-change/readback plus restore must discriminate a dead density applier.

Resolve all local defs/recipes/aliases/compile includes and assets against the actual load composition; current source hashes do not prove deployed hashes. Historical campaign paths are absent, so patched cast and cross-biome dependencies remain unmeasured.
Keep production-kernel C# fuzz (swallow/mire/ladder/vurrak/rules) as regression readings, including deferred mechanisms. Static parsing, mocked plans and Python mirrors never accept gameplay.

Read individual settings flips and effect scopes, derive effective gates through shared kits, persist/reload/reset and verify cleanup on existing effects. Distinct sentinel values, not equality at shipped defaults. Log clean/load/settings are the inherited floor, never extra bars.

Freeze a census of native low-flammability flora including own grass/tall grass; verify inherited flammability and burn spread under shared rules. A gall can burn as a papery insect structure without redefining green native foliage as fuel.

Verify complete object fingerprints and quantity conservation across Scribe, partial stack merge, full map, cancellation, death, settings off and disposal. This catches the current def/stuff/count-only reconstruction risk.

Read field membership per blower rotation, suppression source/expiry, actual grazing writes, weather condition priority, native/airborne immunity and environmental-water eligibility. For R7 default-on readiness, verify the effective Direct Sun gate, qualified shared crown shade and positive exposed radiation exceeding roof/canopy shade at matched positive sun, weather, air and gear. Equal radiation fails that regression check. See T38 for readiness and B6 for the weather experience.

Trace completed ambient-illness/work/tend, ordinary medicine research/craft and lace-use jobs; confirm Frenzy replacement of flu/malaria. Default-off dose/mark/study and their enabled-route regressions live under C11 and T51/T52/T53; saved marks and found-tech counters persist without default effects.
State-read flight tracker for all kept fictional flyers and verify directional whole-body animation paths. Visual flight sessions require the owner; no screenshot claim.

Default-off extra tests read both absent activation and present enabled activation, including indirect incident, damage-trigger, recipe, job, letter and startup-patch routes. Alias resolution and other-biome shared services remain present.

Season trace records hourly eligible cells/plants, edible produce, timber, grazing intake, suppression, wildlife births/deaths/hunts/stings, route cost/reachability, job backlog, warning-to-loss times, buried property and unique log signatures; export settings/content fingerprints alongside it.

rules.rule: Only local maps on the existing fixed world are in scope; map-local terrain placement is not planet generation. No alternative planet scoring, new worldgen, repaint or tile-count finding. Root causeways stay static and use the existing fallback-anchor path when living landmarks are off.

Ordinary wet-native regrowth respects floors, edifices and enclosed rooms under ExplosiveGrowth. Paving and sealed churnmud permanently exempt the cells they cover; no edge invasion or upkeep tax bypasses that answer. Natural pressure belongs to used plant-eligible unpaved working routes, including any still-unpaved entrance approach. Normal light-gated maturation replaces old dark-roots wording. Seed passage is off by default. If enabled, every germination candidate must pass the shared SproutRing respectBuiltGround/enclosed-room eligibility test and honour active suppression (T54).

Newly cleared plant-eligible unpaved working routes require maintenance under natural cycles. Initial candidate check envelope: untreated exposed routes show renewed impediment over 1..3 game days; recovery after a 6-hour defence outage is possible. These are Designer tuning hypotheses, not owner numbers or bars; M2 may change them while preserving recovery-first. Early paving may permanently end regrowth at the home doorway; these hypotheses apply only to eligible ground the colony still uses.

Blower protection uses the existing forward arc and suppression expiry; active requires all installed power/fuel/flick prerequisites. It prevents new growth rather than deleting existing thickets. Room cooling is behind it, never deliberate exhaust heating. Grazing writes only on actual ingestion.

Vulnerable grounded travellers mire; Greentide natives and airborne pawns do not. Freeing must yield a reachable nearby firm destination for both subjects and must fail readably when no such destination exists. No new custom job if extending the existing one suffices.

Burial transfers full object state to a saved holder, never reconstructs only def/stuff/count. Stockpiles have no exemption. Corpse, minified and held objects remain visibly excluded; frozen buried time, retained unplaceable remainder and recoverable designations prevent loss/duplication. Turning off new burial never locks old contents away.

Common Direct Sun is geometric with shared tree/roof shade; ambient heat is vanilla air temperature. The legacy per-biome felt-offset extension/prose is not an authorized heat mechanism. Breaklight's ordinary air offset follows R14. The proposed default is Direct Sun active on Greentide maps only with qualified shared tree shade under the standing adopt-or-fall-back test. T38 must establish that prerequisite before R7 default-on readiness; absent qualification, the Direct Sun check is UNMEASURED. An off branch would require an explicit proposal revision, never a silent proof-scene bypass.

Roil is ordinary weather, Breaklight temporarily wins and then returns. No permanent proof-scene lock. Keep the explicitly first-playable shade response and predator hush; hush applies to biome ambience, not machinery, with overlapping reasons owned by the existing shared silence service.

Keep every current roster placement; record multi-homing without eviction. Off-by-default abilities leave ordinary species and old save instances intact. A fictional flyer uses actual flight and directional whole-body animation; proof is flight state, no unattended visual flight test. Natives can use their environmental water.

Keep ambient Frenzy and its work/collapse/treatment-death fork; dose delivery and earned survivor marks/resistance are next version off by default, without deleting saved marks. Keep lace crafting after visible ordinary research with MedicineProduction, total temporary bleed-stop and vanilla care; branch drops/study/hidden-project gating are next version off. Local gates must decouple these extras from retained illness and medicine; preserve their ruled enabled behavior.

Shared settings name the actual owner of each gate. Defaults enable retained mechanics and disable next-version extras. Label Now/new-map/next-start; snapshot prior settings plus derived defs for checks. All-off stops new harm and releases existing traps/protection cleanly without deleting pawns, inventory, or recoverable buried contents.

Do not compensate for experience or population with growing biome danger. Ordinary management uses vanilla work priorities; no forty-pawn manual-order requirement, periodic inventory grants or secret threat cleanup. Bounded shared response budgets remain intact.

Natural host-associated galls are adjacent standalone Things using existing reaction events. On host removal stop future hosting, preserve visible gall/wasp lifecycle and shared population limits. No automatic whole-map replacement loop.

Breaklight keeps the existing +12 °C condition offset from RM_Greentide_Conditions.xml as ordinary air heat under the 2026-10-19 Direct Sun ruling, ‘Hotter air on the thermometer’. At or above its configured cell-air threshold, an unroofed carrier can take the existing seek-shade job to a reachable standable roofed cell within its search radius. The job uses roof status for both origin and destination.

meetings.why: Footing, growth, fallen trunks and rescues can jointly cut the only usable route even if each works alone. Keep a firm rescue route and test full geometry, not pairwise claims. Paving is a permanent exclusion on covered cells, not a contradiction to upkeep on used eligible ground. M2 must replay early-paved-home and fully paved used-route control policies alongside M3 geometry; unknown includes whether resource-route pressure remains meaningful without requiring doorway upkeep.

Wet sprouts feed grazers, grazing suppresses sprouts, falls change canopy/light, and defence changes hauling capacity. Population and coverage can oscillate or collapse in combination. M2 must compare early-paved home approaches against continued unpaved field/harvest/river use and fully paved used-route controls. Covered cells stay exempt without blowers or grazing. Enabled seed passage could bypass blower or grazing suppression and room exemptions unless each seed candidate obeys R2/R4. T54 and separate M1/M3 cases test that path; M2 uses shared wet-native renewal with seed passage off.

meetings.why: Canopy loss, ordinary Breaklight air heat, room cooling and work timing may combine to make recovery impractical. M4 calibrates the natural weather and roof-seeking sequence under R14 and separately checks R7 default-on readiness through the shared tree-shade qualification and exposed-versus-shaded radiation contrast.
Native feeding, water, immunity, canopy gnawing, tree turnover, predator warning and bounded gall responses must support a continuing population and practical retreat with forty colonists.

Hauling, maintenance, rescue, digging and medicine draw on the same workers; ambient Frenzy collapse or a blocked approach can create a three-way rescue/food/health stall. Early paving shifts labour from doorway upkeep into construction and the remaining unpaved resource network; M2 must include that shift.
